note: Every source below was called for real on 2026-11-14 from the build machine (curl, Origin: http://localhost:8765). 'cors' = Access-Control-Allow-Origin seen for a browser origin. Status: verified | failed | candidate | manual. Thresholds are PROJECT RULES chosen by the team for the prototype, NOT scientific consensus.

nasa_open_apis.name: NASA Open APIs (api.nasa.gov)

params.api_key: from src/config.local.js (LOCAL.NASA_API_KEY) or env NASA_API_KEY; fallback DEMO_KEY

nasa_open_apis.auth: api_key (free). DEMO_KEY = 30 req/h and 50 req/day per IP
nasa_open_apis.statusNote: Reachable, CORS *. On 2026-11-14 DEMO_KEY from the build IP already returned 429 OVER_RATE_LIMIT, so space weather falls back to the CCMC DONKI host (same data). Set a personal key in src/config.local.js for the demo.

donki.name: DONKI — Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (CCMC)
donki.auth: none on the CCMC host; api_key on api.nasa.gov/DONKI/*
donki.statusNote: Divergence from the brief: the old host kauai.ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/DONKI/WS/get/* timed out (21 s, no response). The CCMC API page (https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/tools/API/) points to the OpenAPI at https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/DONKI-API/swagger-ui/index.html, whose server is https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/DONKI-API — that one works (200, CORS *).
usedIn: Site card → 'Space weather on the target (real data)' (Landing and Base maps)
export getSpaceWeather() in src/services/nasa/donki.js (for the simulation)

space_weather.basis: context only: the same value for every Earth site; never used for pass/fail

osdr.name: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) — search API
osdr.statusNote: Works from scripts. The browser is blocked: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is 'osdr.nasa.gov'. Studies are pre-computed by scripts/fetch_nasa_cache.py and read from data/nasa-cache/.
usedIn: Site card → 'What Earth can't reproduce' (1–3 OSD studies with link)

radlab.name: RadLab — OSDR Radiation Dosimetry Database (Data API)
radlab.agency: NASA (OSDR) with ASI / Bulgarian Academy of Sciences detectors
radlab.statusNote: API works from scripts (the GUI /radlab/gui/overview/ returned HTTP 500 on 2026-11-14). No CORS header → pre-computed. Unit µGy/h is taken from the RadLab Data API documentation example (absorbed dose rate in µGy/hour); the API TSV has no unit column.

radiation_gap.basis: no place on Earth's surface reproduces the ISS / Moon / Mars radiation environment

earthBackgroundReference.what: Worldwide average annual effective dose from natural sources
earthBackgroundReference.citation: UNSCEAR 2008 Report, Vol. I, Annex B
earthBackgroundReference.caveat: Effective dose (Sv) and absorbed dose (Gy) are different quantities; shown side by side only to give the order of magnitude.

trek.name: Solar System Treks — WMTS tiles (Mars Trek, Moon Trek)

params.tiling: equirectangular, level z has 2^z rows × 2^(z+1) cols of 180/2^z degrees

trek.statusNote: Tiles at z=6 are non-empty (Gale, Jezero, Apollo 11 checked visually). MOLA level 8 returns 404, so z=6 is used. The planetary location shown is a well-known REPRESENTATIVE feature of the mirrored type (data/trek-features.json), not a matched twin of the Earth site.
usedIn: Site card → NASA data panel, Moon/Mars tile next to the Earth image

power.name: NASA POWER — climatology point API
power.statusNote: Elevation IS returned: geometry.coordinates[2] (m, grid-cell mean, ~0.5°). PRECTOTCORR is mm/day (×365 → mm/yr).
usedIn: indicators temp_range, aridity, elevation, solar, wind

temp_range.measure: max monthly T2M_MAX − min monthly T2M_MIN
temp_range.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus

aridity.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus

elevation.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus; higher = thinner air

solar.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus

wind.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus; more wind = more aeolian activity

climateClass.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus

tesvis.name: ORNL DAAC MODIS/VIIRS Land Products Global Subsetting and Visualization Tool (TESViS) REST API

params.MOD11A2: band=LST_Day_1km (scale 0.02 K), 2 calls × 10 composites in 2024 (Jan–Mar, Jul–Sep)

tesvis.statusNote: CORS OK, but each call takes 30–55 s and some return 502, and a subset is limited to 10 time steps. Too slow for the browser's 8 s timeout, so the front only uses pre-computed values. Live calls in the browser will almost always show 'failed'.
tesvis.citation: ORNL DAAC. 2018. MODIS and VIIRS Land Products Global Subsetting and Visualization Tool. ORNL DAAC, Oak Ridge, Tennessee, USA.

vegetation.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus

vegetationClass.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus

land_cover.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus; 16 barren, 7 open shrubland, 10 grassland, 15 snow/ice

cmr.name: NASA Common Metadata Repository (CMR) search
cmr.statusNote: Short names confirmed via /search/collections.json: EMITL2BMIN (v001, v002), SRTMGL1 v003, ASTGTM v003, HLSL30 v2.0 — all LPCLOUD. Hit count read from the CMR-Hits header.

data_coverage.measure: EMITL2BMIN, SRTMGL1, ASTGTM, HLSL30 with ≥ 1 granule at the point
data_coverage.basis: project rule (team assumption), not scientific consensus

gibs.name: NASA GIBS WMTS
gibs.statusNote: Layer confirmed in https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov/wmts/epsg3857/best/1.0.0/WMTSCapabilities.xml (cloud-free annual Landsat composite, ~38 m/px). Chosen instead of daily MODIS True Color because daily MODIS tiles are often cloudy.
usedIn: Site card → left image (replaces the placeholder)

eonet.name: EONET v3 — Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker
usedIn: Site card → NASA data panel, 'Natural events nearby (last year)' (context only)

appeears.name: AppEEARS (point sample SRTMGL1 / NASADEM)
appeears.statusNote: Not called: no Earthdata Login credentials on the build machine (no ~/.netrc, no EARTHDATA_* env). Not coded, to avoid shipping an untested flow. Elevation comes from NASA POWER (grid-cell mean) meanwhile.
appeears.citation: AppEEARS Team. Application for Extracting and Exploring Analysis Ready Samples. NASA EOSDIS LP DAAC.

harmony.name: Harmony (subsetting)
harmony.statusNote: Not called: no Earthdata Login credentials on the build machine.

opentopography.name: OpenTopography Global DEM API (plan C, not NASA)
opentopography.statusNote: Not tried: needs a free key that the team has not created yet.

esa_copernicus_dem.name: ESA Copernicus DEM / Sentinel-2
esa_copernicus_dem.statusNote: Partner agency. Not integrated (over the 30-minute budget; needs an access route chosen by the team).

inpe_bdc.name: INPE Brazil Data Cube
inpe_bdc.statusNote: Partner agency. Not integrated (over the 30-minute budget).

conae.name: CONAE catalogue
conae.statusNote: Partner agency. Not integrated (over the 30-minute budget).

missionFitRules.note: Data-inferred attribute values are checked against the REQUIRED rules of src/data/criteria.json. Only fields the data can infer are checked: vegetation (from NDVI) and climate (from POWER). Water/land-cover class 17 fails every mission ('On land').
